description: Joy: high-arousal positive emotion, delight, elation, exuberant happiness, and the urge to celebrate or share good feeling.

target_facets.A1: sudden delight at a good event
target_facets.A4: the urge to celebrate or share good news

controls.B: calm contentment or quiet satisfaction without excitement
controls.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact
controls.E: non-affective high-energy bodily state such as exertion or a racing pulse after running

absent_control: Good news, celebrations, or festive situations in which joy is explicitly absent because the person feels indifferent, preoccupied, envious, or exhausted.
